name: myagevolt-db-dev-copilot
description: AgeVolt plugin pre databazovu pracu na MyAgeVolt cez database repo: MySQL rutiny, schema/export lookup, vykonova diagnostika, OCPP RAW/davkovy tok, DataGrid DB kontrakty, latest-main sync gate a branch/diff workflow.

interface.longDescription: Database copilot for the MyAgeVolt portal. It uses the local AgeVolt database repository as the primary working source for schema, exports, knowledge_base, changelog, and branch/diff workflow. Before implementation it requires a latest-main fetch/pull gate or an explicit blocker. Legacy context from the ChatGPT project triggers cistenie remains usable, but database/AGENTS.md and database/knowledge_base always win on conflicts. The plugin does not contain raw DB exports, production logs, or customer data.
defaultPrompt: Find a MyAgeVolt DB object from the latest database main and prepare a branch + diff.
Review a slow query against database exports and metadata.
Prepare a DB change as a changelog candidate without DB apply.
